text:
alex: Heads-up — nightly on main turned red: e2e/kv_shard_tests failing consistently. Filing bisect request, need help to find last-good.

ci-bot: Build #4862 failed on ubuntu-22.04: e2e_kv_shard_test timeout at shard_alloc.cc:342
Failed tests: TestKVShardAllocator::AllocStress
Logs: https://ci.internal/4862
Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/4862

jamal: Ugh. I ran a quick grep in recent commits — there was a heap/allocator tweak in 9a7c3b7 two commits ago that touched allocator shard balancing.

maria: last green on main was build #4855 around 1765428800, commit d4b1f2 ('fix: grpc backoff').

sophie: I can run a bisect this morning. Can someone confirm a minimal repro? Is it e2e only or unit too?

alex: e2e fails reproducibly in the nightly docker image. Units pass locally. Repro steps in CI job: ./run_e2e.sh --filter kv_shard
Attach core dumps: s3 link above.

jamal: I'll start git bisect using the build artifacts. Plan: bisect between d4b1f2 (good) and HEAD (bad).

maria: ping @jamal — please use the bisect script: ./tools/ci/bisect-ci.sh --good d4b1f2 --bad HEAD --target TestKVShardAllocator::AllocStress

jamal: Running now. If bisect points to 9a7c3b7 (allocator: shard balancing heuristics), I can revert or open a quick fix PR.

ci-bot: Bisect run started (job 4863). Will post results here when done.

jamal: result: culprit appears to be 9a7c3b7 — change set 'allocator: adjust shard allocation thresholds' — reproduces locally with docker image. I'll prepare a revert PR: #5902

alex: Thanks. @sophie @maria — can someone sanity-check the revert in CI? If green we can merge and cut a canary deploy for dedicated nodes.

sophie: I'll queue a dry-run of the revert branch. Rerunning tests: queued job 4864.

ci-bot: Job 4864 — all e2e tests passed on revert branch. TestKVShardAllocator passed x3.

maria: Nice. Let's merge the revert and roll back the allocator change. Alex, do we need a postmortem?

alex: Short RCA please — include why unit tests missed this, test coverage gaps. I'll schedule a 15-min sync after merge.

jamal: Revert merged (PR #5902). Rolling back to main. Notifying oncall to watch for regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for main@revert-5902 to staging and canary pool. Monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood/canary

alex: Great work, team. Add a follow-up to add a focused unit test covering shard under high-QPS allocations.
